prompt: What is a side effect in a function?
choices: An exception thrown by the function
Any observable action beyond returning a value — I/O, mutation of external state, logging
A return value that is ignored by the caller
A parameter that has a default value
explanation: Side effects include: writing to a file, printing, modifying a field or argument, calling a network API. Functions with side effects are harder to test and reason about because their behavior depends on and changes the world outside the function.
